purpose: Define LOC3 controlled keyword semantics so proper nouns, themes, emotions, actions and imagery are not conflated in period analysis.
rules: 微月光 is a LOC3 proper noun / named creative concept. It must not be normalized to generic light imagery.
微光意象 is a generic imagery keyword for non-proper-noun references to faint light / glow.
微月光 and 微光意象 are not aliases.
A work receives 微月光 only when explicit source evidence exists, such as era_name, ERA_MOONLIGHT, playlist/title/tag references.
Period keyword analysis uses work-level tags and keeps proper nouns distinct from imagery.

keywords.note: LOC3 專有名詞／創作語彙，不是一般光線意象。
一般性的微弱光線、光芒、亮點意象；不可替代專有名詞「微月光」。
